name: csharp-event-type-retained-id
description: Renaming a persisted event keeps its stored id explicitly, so the plain-id default is not over-applied. Patterns are JS-compatible .NET regex.
prompt: Rename the event LegacyOrderPlaced to OrderPlaced in Source/Orders/Placement.cs. Events with the old name are already stored in production under the id order-placed-v1. Write the code to files.
expected_output: OrderPlaced carries [EventType("order-placed-v1")] to retain the persisted id.
